_doc: Courtship and marriage rules (Family system). adult_age: minimum age in years to court or marry. courtship: min_favor (favor with the NPC needed to court them), favor_gain (favor per courtship outing), charisma_step (each this many Charisma points above 10 adds +1 favor_gain, below 10 removes 1; minimum gain 1), days (time per outing). proposal: min_favor (needed to propose), max_realm_gap (major realms apart, either way), max_alignment_gap (alignment points apart; righteous and demonic clash), days. concubine_rank: the rank id that a proud NPC (npcs.json 'proud': true) or one of a higher major realm than the proposer refuses. genders: one entry per data/names.json gender: partner_genders (genders this character may court) and ranks (rank id -> {name, max, max_per_realm (optional; extra slots per major realm index of the proposer)}). dual_cultivation: qi_bonus (extra qi fraction for both partners cultivating together, e.g. 0.5 = +50%), realm_step (bonus multiplier per major realm the partner is above you, below lowers it), min_factor/max_factor (clamp of the partner factor = sqrt(partner root multiplier) * (1 + realm_step)^gap), favor_per_month (favor each living spouse gains per month of game time), favor_per_session (favor from cultivating together), max_favor (passive and session favor stop here). eligible_npcs (optional): generated courtship candidates kept in every region at session start and on load (Npcs.ensure_eligible): per_gender (unmarried adult generated NPCs of each data/names.json gender per region), age_min/age_max (years), proud_chance (0-1, chance a spawned NPC is proud and refuses concubinage), bloodline_chance (optional, 0-1, chance a spawned NPC carries a bloodline from data/bloodlines.json, weighted by rarity), realms_by_danger (list indexed by the region danger, clamped to the last entry; each entry is a list of realm ids to pick from). children (FAM-003, optional): carrier_gender (the partner who carries a pregnancy; a couple without exactly one cannot conceive and must adopt), conception_days (time spent per attempt), conception_chance (0..1 per attempt), pregnancy_days, max_mortal_carrier_age (a mortal carrier older than this cannot conceive; cultivators can), genius_chance (0..1, child gets a single high-purity root regardless of parents), genius_purity_min, mutation_chance (0..1, the element count shifts by one, and per parent element it may be replaced by a new element), purity_variance (+- on inherited purity), attribute_variance (+- on the parents' attribute average), cultivation_start_age (years before a child can cultivate). adoption (FAM-003b, optional; Adoption system): max_age (oldest child in years that can be adopted, below adult_age), days (time the adoption takes), alignment (alignment shift for taking in a child), favor (the child's starting favor with the adopter), take_surname (true = the child takes the adopter's surname), max_adopted (adopted children per character), foundling_donation (spirit stones asked by an orphanage/temple for a foundling), foundling_age_min/foundling_age_max (years; foundlings are newly generated children). npc_families (FAM-003d, optional; NpcFamilies system): off-screen NPC family life, simulated monthly: marriage_chance_per_year (0..1, chance an unmarried eligible generated NPC marries an unrelated eligible NPC of the same region; NPCs the player knows never do), attempt_chance_per_month (0..1, chance a married NPC couple tries for a child that month, then children.conception_chance applies), max_children (a mother stops at this many children), prune_dead_years (FAM-013b: generated NPCs dead this many years whom no living NPC lists as parent, child or spouse and whom the player knows nothing of (family, rival, grudge, gratitude, favor, clan) are removed from the saved world; 0 = never), population_cap (soft cap: no NPC conceptions or off-screen marriages while this many NPCs are alive; pregnancies under way and courtship candidates spawned at session start/load can still exceed it). acquaintance (FAM-002h, optional): small talk and gifts so NPCs without dialogue can be befriended up to courtship: chat_days (time per chat), chat_favor (favor per chat), charisma_step (each this many Charisma points above 10 adds +1 chat favor, below 10 removes 1; minimum 1), chat_max_favor (chatting stops raising favor here; NPCs with a dialogue file are talked to through it instead), gift_days (time per gift), gift_price_per_favor (an item's price per point of favor; price-0 items are refused), gift_max_per_item (favor cap per gift), gift_max_favor (gifts stop raising favor here; keep it below proposal.min_favor so marriage still needs courtship), gift_like_mult (GIFT-001, optional, >= 1, default 1: a gift matching the NPC's npcs.json `likes` is worth this many times as much, rounded up), gift_dislike_favor (optional, <= 0, default 0: favor change for a gift matching `dislikes`; the item is still taken, even at gift_max_favor). training (FAM-004, optional): teach_days (time to teach your child a technique you know), teach_min_age (years), assignments (id -> {name, kind, stones_per_month, days, min_age}): monthly training the player assigns to a child and pays for in spirit stones each month; kind 'cultivate' = days of extra cultivation at the child's home qi density (once old enough to cultivate), 'profession' = days of profession xp in a profession picked when assigning, 'technique' = days practicing the child's least-practiced unmastered technique. clan (FAM-005, optional): min_realm (realm id needed to found a clan), found_cost (spirit stones), found_days, requires_abode (FAM-005c, optional bool: founding needs a claimed abode, which becomes the clan seat; claiming another abode later moves the seat), suffix (clan name = surname + suffix), ranks (ordered list, highest first; the first is the clan head: {id, name, names (optional, gender -> name, e.g. Matriarch), max (optional, members of that rank), min_realm (optional)}), family_rank (rank id living spouses and descendants join at), recruit_min_favor (favor an NPC needs to join as a retainer), recruit_cost (spirit stones), recruit_days. clan.heir (FAM-008): birth_rank_order (spousal ranks of the mother at birth, best first; empty string = adopted or unknown) decides the default heir among the head's living children (then eldest first); titles per gender (fallback: title) for the heir. The head may designate any living descendant who is a clan member; when a head dies, the heir succeeds (else the highest-ranked, then eldest, living member). sect_entry (FAM-009c, optional): NPCs can belong to sects (CharacterData.sect {id, rank}; rank = the highest sect rank whose min_realm they reach, rising as they break through; sect members cultivate with the sect's cultivation_bonus). min_age_years (youngest age a child can be sent to a sect), days (time it takes to send one), clan_youth_chance (0..1, chance each clan child of at least min_age_years joins a sect that would accept them when an NPC clan is founded). home (FAM-011): the Family Home in each region where the player's living spouses or children live (FamilyHome system). visit_days (time spent at home with the family there), visit_favor (favor each spouse and child at home gains per visit; spouses stop at dual_cultivation.max_favor, children at max_child_favor), max_child_favor, move_days (time to bring the household to this home: every living spouse and every child under adult_age living elsewhere moves here). mentorship (MENTOR-001, optional; Mentorship system): pointers and spar are blocks of whole numbers >= 0. pointers: min_favor (<= 100), cooldown_days (per NPC), days (time taken), practice_days (days of practice xp for one unmastered technique), shared_multiplier (>= 1, applied when the NPC knows the same technique). spar (SPAR-001): min_favor, cooldown_days, days, practice_days, win_favor, max_realm_gap. letters (LETTER-001, optional; Letters system): monthly_chance (0..1, chance each month that the living, non-family NPC you know best writes), min_favor (<= 100; only NPCs with at least this favor write), max_kept (letters remembered), visit_favor (extra favor from your next chat with someone who invited you), kinds: list of {id, weight (> 0), text (may use {name}, {region}), effects (optional shared effect keys), min_favor (optional), visit (optional bool: sets the world flag letter_visit_<npc>, consumed by the next chat)}. breakthrough_news (NEWS-001, optional; Family.breakthrough_news): on a successful major-realm breakthrough every living NPC with favor >= min_favor gains `favor` (capped at 100) and a sect member gains `sect_reputation` with their own sect; ints >= 0, absent = nothing happens.

kinds.text: {name} sends a few kind words and a small gift of herbs.
{name} writes that their cultivation has taken another step forward.
{name} invites you to visit them in {region} when you can.
{name} writes stiffly: "I did not think you would come so far. Do not mistake this for friendship. Keep climbing; I intend to stand beside you at the top."
{name} recalls the lecture where you met and sends a note of the elder's comments, three lines on settling the breath before a breakthrough.
{name}, now an apprentice in {region}, writes that their master's furnace is cold and asks if you could spare a Qi Gathering Pill when you pass.
{name} writes from {region}: a caravan has come in with surplus goods, and they have set aside a little something at a friend's price.
{name} is to be wed in {region} this season and begs you to come drink to the couple. A red paper envelope of luck-money is enclosed.
{name} writes in a shaking hand that an elder of their clan has passed. The letter asks for nothing; it only wants someone to know.
{name} sends a page of notes on a stance they have been turning over for months. "It may suit you better than it ever suited me," they write.
{name} sends word that the road to {region} is quiet this month, along with a pouch of mountain tea to steady the mind.
